metadata.description: Short alphanumeric organization identifier used as the leading segment of all resource names.
Deployment environment label (dev, prod, or custom abbreviation).
Application (client) ID of the Cloud Imaging Portal SPA Entra ID app registration. This is the audience the Portal backend validates browser sign-in tokens against.
Application (client) ID of the Cloud Imaging Media Builder (native public client) Entra ID app registration. Used by the Operator API to validate user tokens originating from the Media Builder.
Entra ID tenant ID (auto-populated from portal session).
Deploy Azure Application Gateway WAF_v2 in front of Device Gateway API (Enterprise tier).
Boot media certificate validity period in days.
Application (client) ID of the manually-created Operator API Entra app registration. Used to configure the Operator API token validation audience (FR-040b).
OS image SAS token URL expiry in minutes.
Boot image SAS token URL expiry in minutes.
Clock skew tolerance for token expiry validation in seconds.
Subnet for Function Apps (Device Gateway, Operator, Imaging Core).
Elastic Premium SKU for all API Function App plans. EP1 is required as the minimum for mTLS, VNet integration, and pre-warmed instances.
PremiumV3 SKU for the Cloud Imaging Portal backend App Service plan.

Principal ID of the Device Gateway API managed identity. Granted Storage Table Data Contributor on the app storage account for the device-session token store, boot-media thumbprint cache, and single-use proof-of-possession nonce store (FR-069).

siteConfig.ipSecurityRestrictions: [if(parameters('deployApplicationGateway'), createArray(createObject('ipAddress', parameters('agwSubnetPrefix'), 'action', 'Allow', 'priority', 100, 'name', 'AllowApplicationGatewaySubnet', 'description', 'Allow traffic from Application Gateway subnet only (FR-042)'), createObject('ipAddress', 'Any', 'action', 'Deny', 'priority', 65000, 'name', 'DenyAll', 'description', 'Deny all other inbound traffic')), createArray())]
